human_tolerance.notes: Abundant and fairly tame; common in urban and suburban neighbourhoods, where it perches on television antennae and fence or electric wires. Often found well away from water.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Breeding season March to June per Wikipedia; regional timing varies with rainfall and is not separated by region here.

vocalizations.description: Nasal trilling call, rendered as 'tree-tree-tree-tree' and usually given in flight. The shared program also uses this call for alarm and song cues; no separate alarm or song is described in the consulted source.

external.note: iNaturalist 2229 (Wikidata P3151, matches iNat taxa API), NCBI 457316 (P685), eBird grbeat1 (P3444), ITIS 554654 (P815) all from Wikidata; ITIS and NCBI not independently re-checked.

range.note: Country list derived from the text 'coastal southern Iran east through the Indian subcontinent to Vietnam'. Not checked against GBIF country occurrences; PK and Nepal/Bangladesh/Sri Lanka follow the subcontinent wording.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Wikipedia describes perching, sallying in flight and some walking/hopping; Hop is included because the shared program feeds by hop.

traits.perching.note: Hunts from low perches and uses fence and electric wires.

traits.nest_type.note: Tunnel up to 1.5 m long dug into a sandy or mud bank; mapped to the Burrow enum.

traits.mass_kg.note: EltonTraits BodyMass-Value 14.8 g, source Dunning (2008), via EltonTraits row SpecID 1667. Single value; not cross-checked against AVONET.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of 16-18 cm, excluding the 7 cm elongated central tail feathers (tail_ratio carries the tail).

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits Diet-Inv 100 (Ref_6). Wikipedia: mainly insects, especially bees, wasps and ants.

traits.social.note: Wikipedia: usually seen in small groups, communal roosts of 200-300. Group size bounds are judgement; the roost size is not used.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Wikipedia describes daytime hunting and roosting; no nocturnal activity described.

traits.defense.note: Judgement: flees from threats, consistent with wariness and the shared program's flee behaviour.

traits.wariness.note: judgement: Wikipedia calls the species 'fairly tame'.

habitat.use.note: judgement: perches on wires and low branches; ground use from walking and bathing in sand. Not a measured split.

habitat.density_per_ha.note: Wikipedia densities by habitat in southern India: riverside 157/km2 (1.57/ha), agricultural 101/km2 (1.01/ha), 43-58/km2 near habitation (0.43-0.58/ha). Study design not in the consulted text, so min/typical/max are from different habitats rather than a sampled range.

seasonal.strategy.note: Wikipedia: resident in South Asian lowlands with short-distance seasonal movements tied to rainfall. Changed from PartialMigration because no sourced winter fraction exists.

behavior.note: Program choice is a limitation: the shared program feeds by hopping on the ground and has no aerial sally action. See PR note.

seasonal.phases.note: Breeding March to June per Wikipedia; not separated by region.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Stage list only; no durations given (Wikipedia: 14-day incubation, fledging in 3-4 weeks, not recorded here).

habitat.resources.note: Judgement weights. Invertebrate predation from EltonTraits diet. Nesting mapped to the cavity tag as the nearest available tag for a sandy-bank tunnel (Wikipedia). Perch shelter from perching behaviour.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: judgement: communal roosts in trees (Wikipedia), mapped to shrub_thicket as the nearest tag.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Wikipedia: common in urban and suburban neighbourhoods; perches on antennae; 'fairly tame'.

look.note: judgement: colours and proportions from Wikipedia's plumage description (green body, blue-tinged throat, rufous-golden crown, black eyestripe, crimson iris, long central tail). Authored mesh, not a measured model; needs visual review.
